stories.title: 2026 Winter Olympics get underway with opening ceremony in Milan
stories.summary: Elegant and energetic, Milan puts its best foot forward to kick off the 2026 Winter Olympics with a star-studded opening ceremony.

stories.title: Japan's first female prime minister stakes her future on snap elections
stories.summary: Japan's first female premier has called snap elections for Sunday. She seeks a mandate for what could be sweeping changes and possibly a lurch to the political right.

stories.title: Seahawks vs. Patriots: The Super Bowl rematch no one expected when the season began
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Nora Pinciotti of The Ringer to preview this year's Super Bowl matchup between Seattle and New England.

stories.title: California's largest children's hospital system discontinues some gender-affirming care
stories.summary: Two hospitals in California are discontinuing hormone treatments for transgender youth, citing Trump administration pressures. In the past year, many hospitals and clinics have scaled back that care.

stories.title: Wall Street's latest wild week
stories.summary: The Nasdaq had its worst days since April's tariff turmoil, as investor worries mounted about an AI bubble -- but there were some non-tech bright spots.

stories.title: A study of a remarkable bonobo named Kanzi shows apes may play make believe
stories.summary: The ability to imagine -- to play pretend -- has long been thought to be unique to humans. A new study suggests certain apes may be able to as well.
